This watershed report was completed while auditing **ESM 224: Hydrologic Modeling**, a graduate level course at the UCSB Bren School of Environmental Science & Management. In this project, I used the Hydrologic and Water Quality System (HAWQS) to evaluate discharge in the Santa Ynez River watershed under different climate scenarios (RCP 4.5 and RCP 8.5). I paired the modeling with mapping of topography, soils, land use, and sub-basin boundaries using ArcGIS Pro to better understand spatial patterns in runoff responses.
